title: Untitled (gouache in a sketchbook, on the shingle)
service: Hugging Face Space Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo, anonymous Gradio API (no account)
prompt: Photograph of an open artist's sketchbook lying on a beach pebble, a quick plein air gouache sketch painted across the right hand page, loose opaque brushstrokes of grey sea, pale sky and dark rust brown, showing the ruined West Pier at Brighton, a skeletal blackened rusted iron pavilion frame with curved roof ribs and no roof, standing alone out in the sea on thin iron legs, not connected to the shore, the left page blank cream paper, visible paper texture and dried paint ridges, natural daylight, realistic
settings: resolution 1248x832, seed 21, 9 steps, shift 3.0; native output 1248x832, stored as JPEG q92
terms_note: Model and Space are both Apache 2.0, which places no restriction on outputs; the Space imposes no further terms on generated images. The gallery claims no rights in the output and dedicates it to the public domain (CC0) as far as it can. Fabricated painting: nothing in it was ever painted, drawn or printed by hand.
note: The prompt was written by the curator, an AI. Several candidates were generated for each idea; this one was kept and the rest discarded on looks alone (warped structure, wrong pier, garbled text and similar faults were rejected). The image is shown unedited apart from resizing for the web.
